title: 第7章 立场互换
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

因为他们很确信，这个气度，这个言行，这绝对是一个远超他们想象的大贵族！

刻在骨子里的尊卑概念和身份上的巨大差距，让本就选择了低头的他们，越发畏惧和顺从了起来。

寓乐没有说话，他们也不敢抬头，只能焦虑无比的等着。

只觉得气氛愈发压抑要命。

他们只是一群低贱的废料，基因纯度连百分之五都过不了。

完全理解不了这种至少三成像人的大贵族究竟是怎么想的。

更遑论，对方可能三成不止。

其实这不是寓乐故意吊着他们。

实在是大起大落后，没啥力气了。

甚至寓乐都觉得自己低血糖要犯了。

终于，熬过了所有人都觉得艰难的几分钟或者几十分钟后。

寓乐才总算开口了。

“我很高兴在这种鬼地方，还有几个正常的人。你们比那群蛮子聪明多了，不是吗？”

三等人头人大大松了一口气。

总算是说话了，而且听起来，这位大人心情不错。

“很荣幸您能这么想，以及，我谦卑的希望您能知道，我们其实一开始就打算把您从这群蠢货手里救出来，我们绝对不是和他们一样迟疑了。”

“我们，我们只是需要时间来进行周密的安排，毕竟我们不能让尊贵的您有任何损失。幸得人类荣光庇佑，您安然无恙！”

寓乐担心他们因为自己也迟疑了，而动手。

他们也同样担心这一点，被寓乐算账。

所以他们的措词都万分小心，不过，这对寓乐来说，显然多余了。

因为他和对方是‘一拍即合’的！

就是，什么是幸得人类荣光庇佑？

还有那个劳森子的基因纯度又究竟是什么玩意？

寓乐对这个世界的世界观依旧茫然无比，但他也不忘记借坡下驴道：

“我知道，对了，你叫什么名字，至少，我得知道救了我的人叫什么。”

头人左右看了看自己的同伴，然后说道：

“我没什么能够入耳的名字，还是、还是不要脏了您的耳朵为好，只是，我希望您能记得我们的定居点。”

“我们的定居点是奴们诺尔386号定居点。”

他试图把拯救大贵族的功劳，变成整个定居点的功劳。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Because they are convinced that with this demeanor and words and deeds, this is definitely a great nobleman far beyond their imagination!

The concept of superiority and inferiority engraved in their bones and the huge gap in status made them, who had already chosen to bow their heads, become more fearful and submissive.

Yu Le didn't speak, and they didn't dare to raise their heads, so they could only wait anxiously.

I just feel that the atmosphere is getting more and more depressing.

They are just a bunch of lowly trash whose genetic purity cannot even pass 5%.

I can't understand at all what this kind of noble man who is at least three-quarters of a human is thinking.

Not to mention, the other party may be more than 30%.

In fact, this is not because Yule deliberately hangs them.

It’s really that I have fallen behind so much and I have no energy left.

Even Yule felt that he was going to suffer from hypoglycemia.

Finally, after a few or dozens of minutes that everyone found difficult.

Yu Le finally spoke.

"I'm glad that there are still a few normal people in this hellish place. You are much smarter than those barbarians, aren't you?"

The third-class headsman breathed a huge sigh of relief.

He finally spoke, and it sounded like the adult was in a good mood.

"I'm honored that you think so, and I humbly hope that you can know that we actually planned to rescue you from these idiots from the beginning, and we are definitely not hesitant like them."

"We, we just need time to make careful arrangements. After all, we cannot let you, the noble one, suffer any loss. Fortunately, thanks to the blessing of human glory, you are safe and sound!"

Yule was worried that they would take action because he hesitated.

They are also worried about this and will be settled by Yule.

So they were very careful with their wording, but for Yule, this was obviously superfluous.

Because he and the other party ‘hit it off’!

That is, what does it mean to be blessed by the glory of mankind?

And what is the genetic purity of the Lawson child?

Yule was still at a loss about the world's outlook on the world, but he did not forget to follow the donkey's path:

"I know, by the way, what's your name? At least, I need to know the name of the person who saved me."

The leader looked around at his companions, and then said:

"I don't have a name that can be heard. It's better not to dirty your ears. However, I hope you can remember our settlement."

"Our settlement is Numen Noor Settlement No. 386."

He tried to turn the credit for saving the great nobles into the credit for the entire settlement.
